name: Mirror Orbit
description: Animated radial reflection that turns footage into a symmetrical kaleidoscopic pattern.
author: ozonerepublic74d77777

parameters.name: Segments
parameters.description: Sets the number of repeated radial sections.

parameters.name: Center
parameters.description: Moves the symmetry point across the frame.

parameters.name: Rotation
parameters.description: Rotates the radial arrangement in radians.

parameters.name: Zoom
parameters.description: Controls how much of the source image appears inside each sector.

parameters.name: Alternate Mirrors
parameters.description: Alternates reflected and non-reflected sectors when enabled.

parameters.name: Seam Feather
parameters.description: Softens the boundaries between repeated sectors.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Blends the radial pattern with the original footage.
